title: Field
summary: The label, help, error, warning and counter around a form control, with the wiring between them. It hands its label and messages to the control, because ids do not cross shadow roots.

props.name: label
props.description: The label text (or use the label slot).

props.name: error
props.description: An error message; puts the control into the invalid state.

props.name: warning
props.description: A warning message; puts the control into the warning state.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required (a star, and required on the control).

props.name: max
props.description: Counter maximum: shows length / max and turns warm from 90% and red past the max; 0 hides the counter.

props.name: layout
props.description: stack puts the label above the control; row puts it in a fixed column beside it (stacks on a phone); inline puts label and control on one line at their natural width.

props.name: size
props.description: sm is the compact field of a toolbar or filter row: smaller label, tighter gap.

slots.description: The control: an pk-* form control or a native input, select or textarea.

slots.name: label
slots.description: A rich label (overrides the label prop).

slots.name: label-action
slots.description: A small action beside the label, such as a reset to source button (a pk-button size mini, variant ghost). Clicking it does not focus the control.

slots.name: help
slots.description: Rich help text (overrides the help prop).

parts.name: field
parts.description: The grid that lays out label, control and foot.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The label wrapper (click focuses the control).

parts.name: error
parts.description: The error message (a polite live region).

parts.name: warning
parts.description: The warning message (a polite live region).

cssProperties.name: --pk-field-label-width
cssProperties.description: Label column width of the row layout.

writes.target: the slotted control (a pk-* element or a native input, select or textarea)
writes.why: A pk-* control takes the label, description, required, invalid and warning props (each only when the control has that prop, and label only when the control has none of its own); a native control takes aria-label (when it has none), aria-description, aria-invalid and data-invalid. aria-description and aria-invalid are removed again when the help or error goes. The props and attributes stay when the field disconnects.

a11y: The label click focuses the control. Ids cannot cross shadow roots, so the field sets label, description (help plus error), invalid, warning and required on an pk-* control, or aria-label and aria-description on a native one. Messages are polite live regions that are empty until used; the star is aria-hidden because required is set on the control.

examples.title: Help, required and counter
examples.html: <pk-field label="Product title" required help="Shown on the storefront and invoices." max="80"><pk-input value="Widget 1 Cover A"></pk-input></pk-field>

examples.title: Error and inline label
examples.html:
<pk-field label="SKU" error="SKU cannot contain spaces."><pk-input value="bad sku"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Weight" layout="row"><pk-input value="6.4"></pk-input></pk-field>

examples.title: Action beside the label
examples.html: <pk-field label="Release date" help="Copied from the source record."><pk-button slot="label-action" variant="ghost" size="mini">↺ Source</pk-button><pk-input value="2026-10-14"></pk-input></pk-field>
